title: Evaluating the Nonlinear Branch at a Positive Input
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: With $f(x)=x+2$ on $x<0$ and $f(x)=x^{2}$ on $x\ge 0$, compute $f(2)$. Would using $x+2$ give the correct value?

steps.title: Select the Active Piece
steps.explanation: The input $2$ satisfies the second condition, so the quadratic branch applies.
steps.why: Every real input satisfies exactly one condition of this piecewise definition.

steps.title: Evaluate the Quadratic Rule
steps.why: Once the correct branch is chosen the evaluation is direct substitution.

steps.title: Reject the Wrong-Branch Computation
steps.explanation: Feeding $2$ into $x+2$ also produces $4$, but that computation is invalid because the linear branch only accepts negative inputs; the agreement is accidental.
steps.why: Matching answers via the wrong piece can hide a conceptual error that other inputs would expose.
